title: Involution of a coordinate flip
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Flipping the coordinates in $S$ twice returns $x$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and $S\subseteq[n]$, and write $x^S$ for the vector formed by flipping exactly the bits in $S$. Then $(x^S)^S=x$.
